name: v3_vs_v2: pre-registered rule for judging RimFlow v3 against the tagged v2 baseline
owner_order: 2026-10-27: "Please ensure that the RimFlow v3 will be able to actively determine if it's actually helping vs. the baseline of the recently tagged Rimflow v2 (Bench + Foundry). We MUST prove that it's superior and at what cost. After it's settled down and optimized of course. One of the v3 roles must own this regular assessment."

week._why: a week ends Monday 07:00 local, before the Operations 07:30 run reads it

v2_history._why: the reference is the tag week (7 days ending Monday 2026-10-26 07:00, the day system-baseline-two-seat-2026-10-26 froze v2). The two v2 weeks before it are shown for context only: v2 was ramping (done 267, 279, 773 a week), so their spread is trend, not noise, and as a band it would call a fourfold drop SAME

band._why: noise from v2's own days: the tag week's 7 days are resampled with replacement 2000 times (seed fixed) and the week's metric recomputed (count: the sum; ratio: sum of numerators over sum of denominators; stock: the sd of the 7 end-of-day readings); sd on the log1p scale for log metrics, absolute for abs. SAME when |v3 - v2| <= max(z * sd * sqrt(2), floor): sqrt(2) because both weeks are noisy

settled._why: a week counts only when its window starts 14 days after the last commit to the v3 config (no enable, cap or rule change for two weeks) and that config enables at least one role; before that every verdict is PROVISIONAL

already_ruled_regex: already (ruled|answered|told|said|decided|asked|gave|gone over|covered)|i('ve| have)? (just )?(already )?(ruled|told you|answered)|i (said|ruled|told you) (this|that) (before|already)|asked (and|&) answered|why (are you|am i) (asking|being asked) (me )?again

metrics.what: items reaching done in the week (rimflow_metrics flow.done)
open items waiting on the owner for more than 3 days, at the week's end
owner messages matching the already-ruled regex (baseline already_ruled.py)
items filed in the week whose cause is an already-done item, over items filed
closes in the week with no verify event carrying a level before the close (baseline ledger_measures.py)
built or validated items waiting for verification, at the week's end
commits in the week touching process paths only, over commits with files (ops_watch process definition)
subagent token use in calls with more than 100k context, over all subagent token use
doing items with a live lease at the week's end, over doing items
open items with a lapsed lease at the week's end
contested claims added in the week
BENCH + FOUNDRY token use in Opus-input-token equivalents (spend_census formula)
token use per item done
subagent transcripts with a call in the week
owner (human-origin) messages to the seats: the proxy for his minutes
distinct hours in which he wrote to a seat: the proxy for his minutes
items filed or spawned in the week
filed minus done, dropped and superseded
median days an owner wait took, for waits resolved in the week
verify fails over verify results in the week
top-level seat token use over all BENCH + FOUNDRY token use
token use in every project family (catches v3 work run outside BENCH and FOUNDRY)

verdict._why: owner by card 2026-10-27 ('Majority of measures'): UNMEASURED: fewer than 4 primaries measured, or ite_wk unmeasured. SUPERIOR: at least 4 of the 7 primaries BETTER, no guard WORSE (a guard past kill_above is WORSE) and no veto primary WORSE (rework_share stands for escaped defects; owner_wait_over_3d and already_ruled_wk for his time); other primaries may be WORSE. WORSE: at least 2 primaries WORSE and not outnumbered by BETTER, or 1 WORSE and none BETTER. Otherwise NOT_SHOWN. Cost is stated beside it: HIGHER if ite_wk or ite_per_done is WORSE, LOWER if one is BETTER and none WORSE, else SAME; with the ratio to the v2 mean

standing._why: over the last 4 settled weeks: SUPERIOR if at least 3 are SUPERIOR and none WORSE; WORSE if at least 2 are WORSE; else NOT_SHOWN. Fewer than 4 settled weeks: PROVISIONAL, whatever the weeks say

counterfactual._why: the simulator's v2 ensemble (240 calibrated members x 2 seeds, structure park), fed the week's observed owner input (presence scaled by his active hours over the tag week's; arrivals per present hour scaled by his messages per active hour over the tag week's), gives a p5-p95 range for what v2 would have done that week. It counts only while the backtest on held-out real v2 weeks covers at least 75% of (week, metric) cells; then a primary called BETTER by the band that is not also past the counterfactual range turns a SUPERIOR week into NOT_SHOWN. It can only lower a verdict, never raise one

amendments.reason: superiority = majority of measures: at least 4 of 7 primaries BETTER, no guard or veto primary (rework, owner waits, already-ruled) WORSE; was at least 2 BETTER and none WORSE
